screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks two LLM optimization strategies (LoRA adapter fusion and output ensembling) on medical QA datasets (MedQA, PubMedQA, MedMCQA), evaluating computational efficiency and accuracy without testing a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
